svg.title: Lumen screen probes: diffuse indirect
svg.desc: Captured buffer visualization. Lumen screen probes: diffuse indirect graph 0001 | ScreenProbeIntegrate SupportAll | pass 181 | view rect 1280x720 valid irradiance/pi (shared tonemap) INVALID_LIGHTING sentinel valid zero non-finite DiffuseIndirectOutput = DiffuseLighting * Diffuse_Lambert(1) = irradiance/pi (LumenScreenProbeGather.usf:1459,1494-1495); the composite later multiplies by diffuse colour. The array is a 1280x888 Texture2DArray slice 0; only the exact 1280x720 view rect is shown. Empty/invalid tiles are categorical magenta; a valid zero is black. The display scale is the 99th percentile of this figure's valid radiance, recorded in display.transform.
